featured_reviews.review_text: They portray themselves as disciplinarian but it's regressive in nature to expect legal adults to follow out-of-date rules. featured_reviews.name: Digvijay Chakraborty
featured_reviews.review_text: I lived here from March 2022 to May 2023. Good place. Rooms are clean and you can ask the housekeeping staff to clean the rooms whenever required. Most of the rooms are AC rooms, just a few rooms in the 193 hostel are non-AC. Hostel 195 is better than 193 in terms of room size. You can take any of the buses from the nearby Sion Bus Stop to Kapol Niwas/Ruia Bus Stop, it costs Rs. 5 to reach Welingkar Institute of Management. Also, there is a Dosa stall just outside the Hostel, Mani Uncle's Dosa, who is available from 7am to 3pm. Dosas are quite cheap and tasty (Rs.20- Paper Dosa, Rs. 30- Masala Dosa etc.) so breakfast is taken care of. The Hostel charges only include only room charges, and there is no food provided, so food arrangements have to be made by the person staying themselves.
